facts.claim: Mariner of the Seas (Royal Caribbean): Entered service 2003; 142,000 GT; 3300 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 323 m length; Voyager class.
Mariner of the Seas has more ways to play on the most maxed-out short getaway ever. Ditch the weekend road trip for an action-packed cruise ship.
Mariner of the Seas is one of five Voyager-class cruise ships of Royal Caribbean International and can accommodate 4,252 passengers.

catalogSpecs.description: Voyager-class; cruise ship operated by its listed cruise line; entered service 2003; 142,000 GT; approx. 3,300 guests at double occupancy.
